body.physical_columns: 8 fixed 30 px columns. Normal labels: 909,808,BREAK,BASS B,BASS A,RVB,DLY,FLT. Drum context instead shows actual voice names or track numbers; unavailable trailing drum tracks remain--.
fields: Selected title localy0..12; selection follows that SMC context, while LOCK separately denotes capture.
Encoder target label y14; authoritative scalar arc center y36,r8; value y46. Value width is trimmed to27px; labels can use FONT_XS.
Fader travel x=column+3,y64..114, actual target marker, and fine white physical-position pickup marker while unpicked and metro condition permits; value y122.
MUTE/SOLO/REC positional rows localy62/74/86, from notes16+n/8+n/0+n; an extra SELECT row y98 appears in eligible FX view. Normal overlay renders three rows, not four.
Touch highlight C_HI applies to the touched fader or knob; title selection, touch, held-FX ownership and pickup are separate signals.
targets: Faders: drum SEQ or drum MIX maps the selected eight-track bank to voice Level; otherwise source main mix levels for five presentation-ordered parts, reverb Level, delay Level, and master DJF/filter.
HOME or MIX page0 knobs: five part Cut/Pan/Rev/Dly banks. Only bank0 provides reverb Decay, delay Feedback and master Resonance tail knobs; other tail slots are NONE.
Drum knobs: selected bank's Pan/Rev/Dly. Other views use two authoritative descriptor pages over eight knobs, suppress duplicated fader/knob targets, and respect captured/peek contexts.
O_ASK maps targets to NONE. Captured engine-bank mismatch or removed song bar must not silently retarget.

Main rows use presentation part_at; FX SELECT follows held bus. Pause0x5D is locked or beat indication; PLAY0x5E is seq.playing; REC0x5F is ui.rec. Outgoing Mackie NoteOn velocity127/0 is source intent, not verified physical LED colour/identity.

power_header_constraints: This receipt adds no power indicator or candidate coordinates. Existing SMC and Loopy painters do not reserve a persistent battery slot.

SMC full overlay already budgets dynamic tag widths around lock, optional held effect and last-control glyph/number; a new power footprint must be explicitly reserved in all four width cases without dropping owner/lock or touching the strip map.
SMC peek uses two 10 px full-width feedback lines. A power treatment must be planned for that separate painter; painting it only in draw_header would be overwritten.
LP header retains mode, dynamic save status, arp clock source, tempo, generic metro/REC and fallback save dot. The apparent gap is state-dependent, not a fixed free slot.
Transient action/pattern headers can replace either normal mode header. A persistent power promise must explicitly handle those replacements; a normal-header-only render cannot prove it.

No battery percentage, charging state, USB-as-charging inference or Elite/Pro equivalence is supplied here. Any future indicator must consume actual admitted power semantics and truthfully represent unavailable/unknown.

PART header has an explicit static snapshot cache with no power field (ui.c5304–5342). A later runtime implementation would need its own invalidation analysis; this source-only design receipt does not implement it.

steps: Use a new isolated exact 3c41 instance and verify exact package/WASM/worklet hashes from retained input receipt. No host feedback injected; release all inputs. Wait for normal ready UI, O_NONE, no help, no pad calibration and no Clip Keys page.

Ensure KEY37 is released while ready, then fresh KEY37 down for an admitted nonzero press interval and up. A 180 ms down plus 200 ms release gap is a conservative existing harness convention, not a measured hardware requirement.
Advance beyond1300 ms from rising press so LOOPY CLIPS toast expires; settle at least one complete UI/LCD transfer. Capture native 240×240 once the LP header and three-line waiting body are visible.
Optional exit is a new KEY37 rising press, followed by release and settling. Do not label LP OFF toast as host disconnect.
If ready/busy/calibration/menu conditions differ, preserve the attempt and inspect actual state; do not patch runtime or inject unsupported host/controller state.
